facts.business: Palash Securities Limited is an investment holding company with an investing business segment earning interest and dividend income, and through its former subsidiary Morton Foods Limited, was also engaged in food processing of canned fruits, vegetables, jams, jellies, squashes and juices until November 18, 2025.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure - Property, Plant and Equipment (Food Processing Business)

key_risks: Loss of control over material subsidiary Morton Foods Limited which became an associate
Going concern uncertainty for associate Morton Foods Limited
Non-compliance with QR code requirement in Hindi newspaper advertisement of financial results
facts.related_party_note: Sale of 7,44,700 equity shares held in Morton Foods Limited to Ganges Securities Limited approved by shareholders via special resolution on September 24, 2025
